notes.purpose: Single machine-readable release-train authority. A requested release version selects one exact Feature; that Feature names its own authority parent, its closeable mandatory children, the prerequisites that must be resolved before its candidate can be accepted, the evidence it requires, the cross-version references it consumes, its lineage and its declared non-blockers.
notes.replaces: This file replaces the former .github/release/v1-mandatory-issues.json, whose entire content is carried by the 1.0.0.0 train below. There is deliberately no second active authority.
notes.semantics: Version digits identify coherent product states and never encode frontend, platform, Qt family, UI family or CI lane. A train that is merely representable never blocks an earlier train, and the number 1.2.0.0 existing does not authorize it.

field_semantics.authority_parent: The issue that owns this Feature's scope and acceptance.
field_semantics.mandatory_children: Closeable product and release-contract work of this exact Feature. Every one of these must be closed before the Feature can be accepted.
field_semantics.candidate_prerequisites: Risk, evidence and governance gates that are not product features but block candidate acceptance while unresolved. A prerequisite is never part of the product work breakdown.
field_semantics.required_evidence: Names of evidence contracts this Feature must produce. A name is a contract to be proved, never a substitute for an issue's live state.
field_semantics.cross_version_references: Other versions' material whose evidence this Feature consumes. Referenced, never required to close as a whole.
field_semantics.non_blockers: Work that is explicitly not required for this Feature, so a later train cannot silently become a blocker for an earlier one.
field_semantics.lineage_parent: The exact accepted Feature this one is built on. Absent for the first release of a line.
field_semantics.scope_status: active (default) when the train is selectable; retired for a pre-reserved technical train slot that #333 withdrew from selection - the record stays as historical provenance and selection fails closed.

notes.fail_closed: Unknown versions, retired planning labels, trains whose scope_status is retired, records whose mandatory_children are absent or empty while the Feature is active, prerequisites that are malformed or that overlap the mandatory set, an unknown or self-referential lineage parent, conditional versions without recorded activation, and note keys that belong to no classified list all fail selection instead of answering.

conditional_trains.rule: V0.4.0.0 is qualification only (the Release Candidate line). It becomes a Feature record here and in trains only when its activation authority records that the V0.3.0.0 self-service foundation is complete, the activated V0.3-family pre-GA baseline (#343/#370) is complete, and the GA support matrix is frozen. At activation its lineage_parent is the completed, activated V0.3-family outcome - never a pre-reserved technical slot; the former 0.3.2.0 coupling was retired with #333.

0.1.0.0.rule: The V0.1 user promise is the release authority. Later-train work and cross-version umbrellas are referenced, never required to close; prerequisites gate candidate acceptance without entering the product work breakdown.

notes.143: Secure remote access is a mandatory child because the trial needs a usable and truthfully reported transport, not because an encrypted profile has to exist before the first candidate can be accepted. The shipped facts - authentication off, no transport encryption, remote input off, listener on the host's IPv4 interfaces - are what this train requires to be stated truthfully; encrypted-profile work still being unfinished is not a blocker for it.
notes.258: Security-modelling entry preflight for the secure-remote Feature. Preflight is risk work, not product implementation, so it is a prerequisite rather than a mandatory child.
notes.271: First real customer trial on the frozen candidate. One real user in one real environment is what the trial requires; Windows and Ubuntu are the internal qualification matrix, and the trial records whichever platform that user actually had. Product-owner decision: the first customer trial belongs to V0.2.0, not to V0.1.
notes.326: The unified build/install entry point and the single user-facing install tree are mandatory children because the trial cannot start from developer intermediate output.
notes.332: Bilingual release notes are a candidate prerequisite: a release that states its facts in one language only has not stated them to its users.
notes.170: Session operations are an evidence-driven optional/differentiating capability. #333 retires the pre-reserved 0.2.1.0 slot; no exact Feature version is assigned until a coherent product outcome is explicitly activated. Declared non-blocker here.
notes.239: Minimal operational examples for session operations share the same evidence-driven optional classification; no exact Feature version is assigned. Declared non-blocker here.

0.2.0.0.rule: The V0.2 user promise is the first real user trial of remote access across a local network, with every fact the user is told matching what the artifact actually does. A candidate is accepted on the facts it ships - a listener reachable on the host's IPv4 interfaces, authentication off, transport encryption off, remote input off, which is not Internet-safe - and it is never blocked by an encrypted profile still being unfinished. Evidence must name those facts, the staged artifact that carries them and the bilingual release notes that state them, rather than any trust state the product cannot verify for itself.

0.2.0.1.rule: V0.2.0.1 is a bounded maintenance repair of the accepted V0.2.0.0 First User Trial lineage. It restores the released Windows/Linux build, install, deployment and runnable-example promise without adding V0.3 capability.

0.3.0.0.rule: V0.3.0.0 Product Preview is the self-service adoption foundation: four-peer SDK/deploy productization (#264), task-oriented self-service docs/examples (#240) and minimum self-service diagnostics (#335). It builds directly on the accepted V0.2.0.0 First User Trial lineage. The mandatory pre-GA V0.3-family baseline under #343/#370 - Qt 5.15/6.5/6.8, Windows/Linux, x86_64/ARM64, the qwindows/qxcb/Wayland/EGLFS reference cells, practical compressed + incremental/damage delivery, maintained viewer interoperability and the #370 performance programme - carries no pre-reserved exact Feature version and is not a mandatory child of this exact Feature; branding (#241) and HyRemoteTool (#378) are optional/differentiating outcomes.
